title: ClusterCockpitReplyMessage
description: Cloud → cluster acknowledgement for every gate frame (accepted:true or drop). Sender: generacy-cloud#887. Consumer: packages/cluster-relay in the generacy repo. Unknown top-level fields are preserved (.passthrough() in Zod); frameType, wroteDoc, and reason are open strings (Q2=A) — enumerated values are informational only.

timestamp.description: Cloud-side send time. Format is loose — not required to be strict ISO 8601.

frameId.description: Correlation id echoed from the outbound gate frame. `null` today (orchestrator's outbound GateOpenSchema strips unknown keys); becomes a real id in #1059 steps 4–7.

frameType.description: Which frame class this reply acknowledges. Known values (informational): 'gate-open', 'gate-outcome', 'unknown'.

gateKey.description: Present when cloud resolved a run-scoped gate identity; absent otherwise.

accepted.description: Router branches on this. true → debug log with full parsed object. false → info log with reason + frameType + gateId + priorStatus.

reason.description: Short reason code. Present on drop paths and sometimes on happy path. Open string (Q2=A) — informational values include 'schema-invalid', 'stale', etc.

priorStatus.description: Present on some drop classes; undefined on `accepted: true`.

wroteDoc.description: Present only on `accepted: true`. Known values (informational): 'created', 'rebound'.
